items.label: Volex press release: Preliminary Group Results for the Year Ended 31 March 2026 (06-25-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Data-centre capability and capacity: Volex's high-speed data cable

set.signal: Data-centre capability and capacity: Volex's high-speed data cable capabilities now reach 1.6 terabit-per-second, the output of expanded R&D focused on Data Centres and EV & Electrification; ongoing certification across successive cable technology generations makes each product step more technically demanding and higher-value. FY2026 capital investment of $34.8 million (2.8% of revenue) focused on capacity at sites supporting Data Centre and EV & Electrification customers; an expansion project in Mexico was completed during the year, and approximately $26 million of the FY2026 investment targeted Centres of Excellence projects, including a $6 million investment in expanding the San Luis Potosi site. Through proactive supply chain management Volex handled a significant ramp-up in output; inventory investment to support accelerated Data Centre demand (a hub model with a longer cash cycle) caused a $67.9 million cash outflow.

items.reason: The release states the completed Mexico expansion and the $6 million San Luis Potosi investment in separate passages (the latter under Centres of Excellence); it never says they are the same project, so the parenthetical link was an inference.
items.evidence: including a $6 million investment in expanding our site in San Luis Potosí. ... with an expansion project in Mexico completed during the year.
